column1: # M8 DN-0 symbol-to-bucket map. FROZEN with the DECLARATION; never edited after the first leg.
# Applied by attribute.py to every perf sample's user call chain (leaf first):
#   1. each frame's symbol is normalized: "(anonymous namespace)" -> "{anon}", then cut at the
#      first "(" (a lambda or a template instantiation is named by its enclosing function);
#   2. frames are scanned LEAF -> ROOT; the FIRST frame matching ANY row decides the sample, and
#      within that frame the FIRST matching row (file order) gives the bucket;
#   3. a pattern is a Python regex matched (re.search) against the normalized name with the
#   4. external libraries (MKL, LAPACK, libc, libstdc++, libgfortran, CUTEst, Eigen, fmt) carry NO
#      row: they are transparent and take the bucket of the hven/harness frame that called them;
#   5. a chain in which NO frame matches falls back on its LEAF: ld-linux -> B_proc; an MKL/LAPACK/
#      OpenMP-runtime symbol or libiomp5 -> B_fac; libcutest/libpb/libgfortran -> B_eval;
#      anything else -> B_eng. Fallback and unmatched shares are reported per cell.
# B_proc (process start/exit and harness-only work: option labels, row emission, the options
# dump the runner asks for) is reported but EXCLUDED from the total the rule's shares read.
